fidelity_rules: Final accepted record state and final NODES/ALIASES/EDGES intersection governs retained source payload.
Planned, observed, held, excluded, inactive and dictionary-component observations do not reserve keys.
Existing-owner lexical diminutives/subtypes keep their exact selected owner senses; they are not universal synonyms.
All original holds, forms and claim provenance remain preserved; source review does not grant target, round or integration approval.
